title: Mother Feeding Baby in High Chair, 1956 Kitchen Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A tender mid-1950s domestic snapshot capturing a young mother leaning against a kitchen counter while gently feeding her infant seated in a wooden high chair. The cozy home interior is decorated with whimsical patterned wallpaper and classic 1950s furnishings, reflecting everyday American family life during the height of the post-war baby boom era. The border is stamped 'JAN 56' along the top scalloped edge.
